verdict.rationale: The pack never documents SMS auto-replies, scheduled texts, missed-call text-back or after-hours text replies. Business SMS Booster lists only a shared inbox, templates and compliance tools. The SMS-sending API, event notifications, call-handling rules and the unspecified Workflow Builder are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
